verdict.rationale: Mixpanel documents a Query API that returns the same calculated results as its web-app reports, including filtered and broken-down events, user profiles, activity streams and cohorts. It also documents a Raw Event Export API that returns event data as JSONL with all properties and is recommended for high-volume exports, plus JQL for custom queries. Both the Query and Raw Data Export APIs ship OpenAPI specs. Missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of query and export API behavior; the only community comment is a vague remark that the 'export policy is great'.

support.subject: As a developer, I can run analytical queries and pull raw event data back through a documented query/export API

citations.quote: The Query API allows you to obtain the same calculated and formatted results that you see from a report in our web app.
The Mixpanel Query API endpoints can: Filter or break down Events
To export raw event data, use the Raw Event Export API. The events payload is returned as JSONL
The raw export API allows you to download your event data as it is received and stored within Mixpanel, complete with all event properties
Create custom queries using Javascript code
